run_model_zoo_tables: run the python module to generate all MODEL_ZOO.md tables for RegNetX, RegNetY, ResNet, ResNeXt, and EfficientNet model families
build_model_zoo_table: build a MODEL_ZOO.md table for a given model family like RegNetX using timing and error JSON data
create_model_zoo_table_row: create a single HTML table row for a model with its config URL, FLOPs, params, and download link
get_model_data: get model data including FLOPs, params, activations, batch size, inference time, training time, and top-1 error for a named model
review_TABLE_TEMPLATE: review the HTML table template structure used for generating MODEL_ZOO.md tables with model complexity and performance metrics
